name: Camp Bauercrest
description_short: Overnight summer camp for boys 7–17 in Amesbury, MA, built around sports and Jewish values. Families choose a 7-week full summer, one of two 3.5-week sessions, or a 2-week Mini Camp for first-time campers up to 6th grade.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are nonrefundable once a spot is reserved. Cancellations must be sent in writing by email. Pay in full, half in January and half in May, or a 4-, 6- or 8-month plan charged on the 20th. Tuition is due in full by May 20; enrollments on or after May 1 pay in full at enrollment.

warnings: The camp appears to be for boys only ("your son", "Boys 1st-5th Grade Try Camp FREE"), but the page does not say so directly.
Conflicting grade limits for Training Camp: the dates table says "up to 6th grade" but the banner says "Boys 1st-5th Grade".
The early enrollment discount ("enrolling before August 29th") has a deadline that is already past as of today (2026-10-13). Ask whether a 2027 discount is still available.
Visiting Day is listed as Saturday, July 17, which is also the last day of Session 1.
Training Camp is a free 24-hour trial, not a regular session. It is left out of price_min.
The activities list comes from the site's menu links, not from text on this page.
